attributes.title: tag_get_config
attributes.description: Read bounded Tag configuration with system.tag.getConfiguration. The internal UDT definition namespace is reserved for udt_type_* tools.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute provider-qualified Tag, Folder, or UDT instance path outside _types_.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Whether to include descendants. Default false.

parameters.name: overridesOnly
parameters.description: For UDT members on supported Ignition versions, return only overridden properties. Default false.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum configuration nodes after recursive expansion, 1..200. Default 50.
